labels.rationale: Feature request for new ReprHighlighter behaviour (unit styling); new features need Discussions approval first.

items.body:
This is a feature request for new highlighting behaviour. New features need approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) first, so please start a discussion there describing the unit styling you want and the proposed regex.

Related: #3318 covers number highlighting in `ReprHighlighter` for separators and binary forms, which touches the same number patterns.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
